note: M3 audit round 7, auditor A1. Mutants chosen by the auditor; each judged non-equivalent from its diff before the run (see each note). Order matters: the driver's law-run cap is shared by the round and spent greedily in spec order, so the two bundle mutants (which need no law runs) come first, then the one mutant whose whole touched-law set fits the cap (m03), then m04 with its two named laws, then mutants that can only be detected by an extraction rejection or a derivation change within the cap.

mutations.expect: wrong key: the enqueue time of message i is written at i+1, so message 0's time stays 0 and getFirstUnfinalizedMessageEnqueueTime answers block.timestamp while message 0 is pending (the Rollup's L1-message delay check never fires); the queue document's re-extraction must change
